title: Elasticsearch: In specific scenarios involving WebSocket handshake redirects to a different origin, the Reactor Netty…
description: A security vulnerability in Elasticsearch versions prior to 9.2.8-r13 involves the Reactor Netty WebSocket client potentially leaking credentials during WebSocket handshake redirects to a different origin. This issue has been assigned CVE-2026-47848 and carries a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.1. The vulnerability is fixed in version 9.2.8-r13.
